# beecrowd 1154 — Ages (fixture)

Reads a sequence of integer ages from stdin, terminated by a negative value, then prints the arithmetic mean with 2 decimal places.

This fixture is used to validate:
- `Maybe[T]` + `Just(...)`/`Nothing` construction
- `isNothing(...)` and `unwrap(...)` on `Just(...)`
- `while` loops + numeric conversion + `to_string_fixed(...)`
